items.text: Andy Reid on Kenneth Walker III (groin): getting better but 'we just don't want to do something stupid.' Levitan fully agrees—playing him less than 100% would be stupid given huge Week 12 at BUF and Emmett Johnson's recent production. High chance Walker sits again vs ARI.
items.why: Reid caution + Levitan endorsement; Chiefs big favorites and can afford rest
items.implication: Do not start Walker; handcuff/backup elevated

items.text: David Montgomery (groin) off injury report / fully expected to return Thursday vs IND after missing four games. Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out.
items.implication: Start Montgomery as lead back; reverse any Marks beneficiaries

items.text: Drake Maye ankle injury (possible fracture) leaves Patriots cooked; Vrabel already said not ready post-bye. Hard negatives on entire NE offense ROS with Tommy DeVito/backup options and AJ Brown also hurt. Season potentially over for Maye.
items.why: Fracture speculation, movement QB, Vrabel comments, bye doesn't help return timeline
items.implication: Drop/trade Maye in most formats; fade NE pass catchers/RBs heavily

items.text: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) DNP Wednesday, day-to-day / significant but not major. Michael Mayer elevated if OUT vs DEN.
items.implication: Game-time; Mayer TE streamer if OUT

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to foot injury. Trending toward possible miss vs DET; Jalon Daniels could start again.
items.why: Foot strain from prior week, walking boot reports, DNP midweek
items.implication: Monitor Friday; fade Bucs pass game / elevate Daniels if OUT; impacts Bucky Irving script

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is Berry’s RB6 ROS. Full Chub(a) endorsement after strong recent usage.
items.implication: Start/hold confidently ROS; buy if available

items.text: Jordan Addison (thumb surgery) will not go on IR, per Kevin O’Connell. Remains available but timeline unclear for return.
items.implication: Hold in deeper leagues; Jefferson/others absorb targets short-term

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set season-high Pass Rate Over Expectation. O’Connell wants to throw a lot—boosts Justin Jefferson and pass-catchers.
items.why: Season-high PROE with Cousins; prior positive PROE even with bad QB play
items.implication: Jefferson WR1 locked; elevated TE/WR2 upside

items.text: Omarion Hampton finally got lead-back volume (22 carries, 105 yds, TD, 63% snaps). Start him vs Jets with six teams on bye.
items.why: Confirmed lead volume and snap share

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace Week 11: TEN @ DAL up in pace (Titans hurry-up/no-huddle exploding, both teams high play volume). MIA @ BUF slow-paced slog.
items.why: Titans 1st in hurry-up, combined high plays/points lately; Cowboys fast neutral pace
items.implication: Stack/pass-game upside TEN/DAL; fade volume MIA/BUF
items.opportunity: Elevated play volume for skill players

items.text: Berry closing it out on Jalen Coker. Talent there but fantasy production has not been.
Levitan dunks hard on Jonathan Brooks hype: 'The Jonathan Brooks slappies have a mental illness, it's legit scary.'
items.implication: Avoid or sell any Brooks shares; do not roster based on hype

items.text: Berry closing it out on Jaylen Waddle: target share nice but production is not. Full-go in practice post-concussion but still HATE/close-out.
items.implication: Sit/flex down or sell; prefer other options

items.text: Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve and activated S Kerby Joseph from Reserve/PUP. Cam Skattebo retiring celebratory backflips in wake of the injury.
items.implication: Lions defense hit; minimal direct fantasy skill impact beyond IDP
